headline:
A little Christmas.
A lot of skin love.
intro: You don’t need to know their skin. You just need to know their goal.

sets.name: The Instant Glow Edit
sets.strapline: For the friend who wants that fresh-from-a-facial look before a night out
sets.description:
Know someone who loves looking like they've just stepped out of a facial? This is the gift for them. The Instant Glow Edit brings together five skincare essentials designed to cleanse, exfoliate, hydrate and refresh the complexion before a big night out. From smoothing away dull surface skin to delivering an instant hydration boost and a cooling facial massage, it's everything they need for that fresh, polished feeling - at home. And because we've built it around a skin goal rather than a skin type, you don't need to know her entire skincare routine to get it right.

You know the friend. We’ve made the skincare bit easy.
sets.who:
The pre-party facial lover
The one who loves getting ready
The skincare-loving friend
The one who always has plans
The friend who wants her makeup to sit beautifully
The one who loves an at-home pamper
sets.inside:
1 x Enzyme Powder Polish
A water-activated exfoliating powder powered by papaya enzymes and soothing calamine. It gently buffs away dull, dead surface skin to leave the complexion feeling smoother and looking fresher.

1 x AHA! Cleanse® Brightening + Exfoliating Lactic Acid Cleanser 100ml
An active cleanser with 8% lactic acid and 1% PHA that gently exfoliates while helping to hydrate and smooth the look of uneven skin.

1 x NEW Hydra-Hit Instant Facial Mask
A serum-soaked Korean sheet mask that delivers an instant hydration boost in just 15 minutes. Powered by glycerine, niacinamide and panthenol, it leaves skin feeling quenched, soothed and refreshed.

1 x Limited Edition Cryo Ball
A cooling facial massage tool designed to refresh and soothe the look of tired, puffy skin. Glide it over the face for a calming, spa-like finishing touch before getting ready.

1 x Cleanse Off Mitt
A soft, reusable cleansing mitt that removes makeup and daily build-up with warm water. A simple first step to getting skin clean and ready for the rest of the routine.
sets.howTo:
Cleanse Off Mitt
Wet with warm water and gently sweep over the face to remove makeup, SPF and daily build-up. Rinse thoroughly and leave to air dry.
Before a night out: Use as the first step to get your skin clean and ready for your skincare routine.

AHA! Cleanse®
Apply to damp skin and gently massage over the face, avoiding the eye area. Rinse thoroughly with warm water.
Use: 2-3 evenings a week, depending on your skin's tolerance. 

Enzyme Powder Polish
Pour a small amount into your palm and activate with water. Gently massage over damp skin, avoiding the eye area, then rinse thoroughly.
Use alone or add a sprinkle to AHA Cleanse 2-3 times a week to power up your exfoliating action.

Hydra-Hit Instant Facial Mask
After cleansing, unfold the mask and apply to the face. Leave for 15 minutes, then remove and gently massage the remaining serum into the skin.
Before a night out: Use as your hydration step before makeup for skin that feels quenched, soft and refreshed.

Limited Edition Cryo Ball
After cleansing and applying your skincare, gently glide the Cryo Ball over the face using light, outward and upward movements.
Before a night out: Use for a few minutes as the final step of your skincare prep, focusing on areas that look tired or puffy.
sets.ingredients:
Papaya Enzymes: Help exfoliate the skin's surface, lifting away the look of dull, dead skin cells for a smoother-looking complexion.

Calamine: Known for its soothing properties, calamine helps make Enzyme Powder Polish a gentle-feeling exfoliating step.

Lactic Acid: An AHA that exfoliates the skin's surface while helping to support hydration, leaving skin feeling smoother and looking more even.

PHA: A gentle exfoliating acid that helps remove dead skin cells while attracting moisture to the skin.

Glycerine: A humectant that helps draw moisture into the skin, leaving skin feeling hydrated and comfortable.

Niacinamide: A form of vitamin B3 that helps support the skin barrier and improve the appearance of uneven-looking skin.

Panthenol: Also known as provitamin B5, panthenol helps condition the skin and leave it feeling soft, comfortable and hydrated.
sets.tips:
Plan your facial moment.
Use Hydra-Hit for 15 minutes while you're doing your hair, choosing an outfit or simply taking a moment before getting ready.

Bring on the chill.
Use the Cryo Ball after your skincare for a cooling facial massage, focusing on the cheeks, jawline and areas that look tired or puffy.

Give your skin a little time.
Complete your skincare prep before applying makeup, giving each layer a moment to settle.

Keep it simple.
You don't need to use every product in the Edit every time. Think of it as a collection of facial-inspired steps you can use according to what your skin needs.
sets.targets:
Dull-looking skin
Rough or uneven-looking texture
Dehydration
Tired-looking skin
The appearance of congestion
Tired, puffy-looking skin
Skin that looks lacklustre before an occasion

sets.name: The Hydrate + Renew Edit
sets.strapline: For the one who gave everyone else their energy all year
sets.description:
They've spent the year looking after everyone else. Now it's time someone looked after them. The Hydrate & Renew Edit brings together two award-winning daily serums and three extra-special skin treats to help make taking care of their skin feel like taking care of themselves. With hydration, skin-smoothing and renewal-supporting essentials for morning and evening, plus a few moments of at-home pampering, it's a thoughtful way to give something that's just for them.

And because we've built our Edits around skin goals, not skin types, you don't need to know their entire skincare routine to gift it with confidence. You know they deserve some me-time. We've made the skincare bit easy.
sets.goal: Hydrated, nourished, smoother skin - and more me-time
sets.who:
For the one who gave everyone else their energy all year.
They are the one who remembers everyone's birthdays. Checks in on everyone. Organises everything. Somehow knows what everyone needs - and probably puts themself at the bottom of the list. This Christmas, give them something that says “this one's for you.”

Gift it to:
The giver who is always looking after everyone else.
The busy mum who rarely gets a moment to herself.
The friend who does it all and makes it look easy.
The one who deserves some serious me-time.
The skincare lover who enjoys a simple but effective routine.

They spend enough time taking care of everyone else. This one's for taking care of them.
sets.suitability: For all skin types - please note Skin Protein contains a derivative of vitamin A, meaning it is not suitable for anyone that is pregnant or breast-feeding.
sets.inside:
1 x Skin Veg Hyaluronic Acid Hydrating Serum 100ml
A lightweight, multi-tasking hydrating serum with low molecular hyaluronic acid, peptides and gentle PHA. It delivers instant hydration while helping to smooth, brighten and plump the look of skin - including the delicate eye area.

1 x Skin Protein Anti-Ageing Retinoid Serum 100ml
A nourishing retinoid serum with retinyl palmitate, pro-collagen peptide and antioxidant vitamins C and E. It helps smooth, firm and brighten the look of skin while supporting natural skin renewal.

1 x NEW Hydra-Hit Instant Facial Mask
A serum-soaked Korean sheet mask that delivers an instant hydration boost in just 15 minutes. Powered by glycerine, niacinamide and panthenol, it leaves skin feeling quenched, soothed and refreshed.

1 x Limited Edition Cryo Ball
A cooling facial massage tool designed to refresh and soothe the look of tired, puffy skin. Glide it over the skin after cleansing or alongside your serum for a calming, spa-like moment at home.

1 x Cleanse Off Mitt
A soft, reusable cleansing mitt that removes makeup and daily build-up with warm water. A simple first step to a double-cleanse routine and an easy essential for home, travel or the gym.
sets.howTo:
Skin Veg Hyaluronic Acid Hydrating Serum - AM & PM: After cleansing, apply a pump to the face, neck and delicate eye area.


Skin Protein Anti-Ageing Retinoid Serum - AM & PM: After cleansing, apply a pump to the face, neck, decolletage and around the eye area.

Hydra-Hit Instant Facial Mask - After cleansing, unfold the mask and apply to the face. Leave for 15 minutes, then remove and gently massage the remaining serum into the skin.
Use whenever skin needs an extra hydration boost or when she wants a little at-home facial moment.

Limited Edition Cryo Ball - After cleansing and applying your skincare, gently glide the Cryo Ball over the face using light, outward and upward movements. Focus on the cheeks, jawline and areas that look particularly tired or puffy.
Use whenever she has a few extra minutes for a cooling, refreshing facial massage.

Cleanse Off Mitt - Wet the mitt with warm water and gently sweep over the face to remove makeup, SPF and daily build-up.
Use as the first step of a double cleanse, followed by your preferred cleanser.
sets.ingredients:
Hyaluronic Acid: A powerful humectant that helps attract and retain moisture in the skin, helping it feel hydrated and look plumper.

PHA: A gentle exfoliating acid that helps remove dead skin cells while supporting hydration.

Retinyl Palmitate: A retinoid derivative used in Skin Protein to support the appearance of smoother, firmer and brighter-looking skin.

Pro-Collagen Peptide: A peptide selected to help support the look of firmer, smoother skin.

Vitamins C + E: Antioxidant vitamins that help protect against environmental stressors while supporting a brighter, healthier-looking complexion.

Glycerine: A humectant that helps draw moisture into the skin, leaving it feeling hydrated and comfortable.

Niacinamide: A form of vitamin B3 that helps support the skin barrier and improve the appearance of uneven-looking skin.

Panthenol: Also known as provitamin B5, panthenol helps condition the skin and leave it feeling soft, comfortable and hydrated.
sets.tips:
Make Hydra-Hit the “do not disturb” moment.
Apply the mask, set a timer for 15 minutes and use that time for absolutely anything you want - including nothing.

Bring in the Cryo Ball when there's time.
Use it after cleansing or alongside your serum for a cooling facial massage that helps the routine feel a little more special.

Don't forget daytime SPF.
Skin Protein contains a Vitamin A derivative, so daytime sun protection is an important part of any routine.
sets.targets:
Dehydrated-looking skin
Dryness and tight-feeling skin
Fine lines and wrinkles
Loss of firmness
Dull-looking skin
Uneven-looking texture
Skin that looks tired or lacklustre
Tired, puffy-looking skin
sets.gridSubline: Daily hydration and a little me-time.

sets.name: The Anti-Ageing Edit
sets.strapline: For the one who's starting to notice the years.
sets.description:
Fine lines looking a little more obvious? Skin not feeling quite as firm or fresh as it used to? The Anti-Ageing Edit brings together targeted Vitamin A skincare with hydration and facialist-inspired extras to help her take the next step in her routine. Featuring two Vitamin A serums - including our beginner-friendly Skin Protein and a more progressive retinol formula - alongside a hydrating facial mask, cooling Cryo Ball and reusable cleansing mitt, it makes getting started with targeted anti-ageing skincare simple.

Because you don't need to know everything about their skin to choose a thoughtful gift. Just know what they want to work on.

Contains:

1 x Skin Protein Anti-Ageing Retinoid Serum
A lightweight, beginner-friendly Vitamin A serum designed to support smoother, firmer and brighter-looking skin while helping to promote natural skin renewal. With retinyl palmitate, pro-collagen peptide and antioxidant vitamins C + E, it helps soften the appearance of fine lines while leaving skin feeling hydrated and supple.

1 x Retinol + B3 Anti-Ageing Night Serum
A more progressive Vitamin A option for those ready to step up their results. Encapsulated retinol works alongside niacinamide and hyaluronic acid to help smooth the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles, support collagen and skin renewal, and improve the look of uneven tone and texture.

NEW Hydra-Hit Instant Facial Mask
A serum-soaked Korean sheet mask that delivers an instant hydration boost in just 15 minutes. Powered by glycerine, niacinamide and panthenol, it helps refresh the look of dull, dehydrated and visibly red skin, leaving it feeling quenched, soothed and refreshed. Hydration can increase by up to 85% after a single use.*

Limited Edition Cryo Ball
A cooling facial massage tool designed to instantly refresh and soothe the look of tired, puffy skin. Glide it over cleansed skin or alongside your serum for a calming, spa-like facial ritual.

1 x Cleanse Off Mitt
A soft, reusable mitt that removes makeup and daily build-up with warm water. An easy first step to a simple double-cleanse routine, whether she's at home, travelling or heading to the gym.
sets.who:
For the mum who's starting to notice the years.

The one who's saying, "My skin just isn't what it used to be."

They are noticing fine lines, a little less firmness or that their skin needs more from their routine than it once did. 

This is for the mum, sister, friend or partner who's ready to start looking after their skin a little more proactively - without making skincare complicated.
sets.suitability: For all skin types - please note Skin Protein and Retinol + B3 Anti-Ageing Night Serum contain vitamin A and are therefore not suitable for anyone that is pregnant or breast-feeding.
sets.inside:
1 x AHA Cleanse Brightening + Exfoliating Lactic Acid Cleanser 100ml
1 x Skin Protein Anti-Ageing Retinoid Serum 100ml
1 x Hydra-Hit Instant Facial Mask
1 x Limited Edition Cryo Ball
1 x Cleanse Off Mitt
sets.howTo:
Skin Protein - AM & PM - After cleansing, apply a pump to face, neck, decolletage and around the eye area. Use SPF every morning.

Retinol + B3 - Use in the evening after cleansing. Apply a small amount to clean, dry skin and follow with moisturiser. Introduce gradually, particularly if new to retinol. Use SPF every morning.

Hydra-Hit Instant Facial Mask - After cleansing, unfold and apply the mask to the face. Leave for 15 minutes, then remove and gently massage the remaining serum into skin. No rinsing required.

Cryo Ball - Glide over clean skin or alongside your serum using gentle outward and upward movements. Use whenever skin looks tired or puffy and you want a cooling, refreshing facial massage.

Cleanse Off Mitt - Wet the mitt with warm water and gently sweep over the face to remove makeup and daily build-up. Use as the first step of a double cleanse if desired.
sets.ingredients:
Retinyl Palmitate - a retinoid used in Skin Protein to support smoother, firmer-looking skin and natural skin renewal.

Pro-Collagen Peptide - helps support the look of firmer, smoother skin.

Encapsulated Retinol - a progressive form of Vitamin A designed to help smooth the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles and support skin renewal.

Niacinamide (Vitamin B3) - helps support the skin barrier and improve the look of uneven tone and texture.

Hyaluronic Acid - helps attract and retain moisture, leaving skin feeling hydrated and supple.

Glycerine - a humectant that helps draw moisture into the skin for a quenched, comfortable feel.

Panthenol - helps hydrate and soothe the feel of the skin.

Vitamins C + E - antioxidant vitamins that help support the skin against environmental stressors.
sets.tips:
New to Vitamin A? Start with Skin Protein. Introduce it gradually and let skin build tolerance over time.

Already using Vitamin A? Retinol + B3 can provide a more progressive option, depending on their existing routine and experience.

Keep it simple. Vitamin A doesn't need a complicated routine around it. Cleanse, treat and moisturise, with SPF every morning.

Make the extras count. Use Hydra-Hit when skin needs an extra hydration boost and reach for the Cryo Ball whenever they have five minutes me-time.

Don't rush Vitamin A. More isn't always more. Consistency and gradual introduction are key.
sets.targets:
Fine lines and wrinkles
Loss of firmness
Uneven-looking tone and texture
Dull, tired-looking skin
Dehydration
Tired, puffy-looking skin
Skin in need of a more targeted routine

sets.name: The Radiance Edit
sets.strapline: For the one who is permanently exhausted.
sets.description:
Late nights, early starts, busy weeks and very little me-time can all show up on the skin. The Radiance Edit brings together  Vitamin C and Vitamin A skincare with hydrating, skin-comforting extras to help brighten the appearance of dullness, support a more even-looking tone and leave skin looking fresher and more radiant.
With two full-size treatment serums plus a 15-minute hydration hit, a cooling facial massage and an easy cleansing essential, it's a thoughtful way to give their skin a little more care - without asking them to completely overhaul their routine.

You don't need to know their skin inside out to gift skincare with confidence. You just need to know that they could use a little pick-me-up.

Contains

1 x Skin Protein Anti-Ageing Retinoid Serum 100ml
A creamy, hydrating Vitamin A, C + E serum that can be used twice daily to help brighten and smooth the look of skin for a fresher, more radiant-looking complexion. With retinyl palmitate, pro-collagen peptide and antioxidant vitamins C + E, it supports skin renewal while leaving skin feeling soft, supple and nourished.

1 x 15% Vit C, E + Tri-Mushroom Serum
A  15% Vitamin C + E serum blended with reishi, chaga and cordyceps mushrooms. It helps brighten dull-looking skin, improve the appearance of uneven tone and support a firmer-looking complexion, while helping to support the skin barrier for a clearer, smoother and more radiant-looking finish.

NEW Hydra-Hit Instant Facial Mask
A serum-soaked Korean sheet mask that delivers an instant hydration boost in just 15 minutes. Powered by glycerine, niacinamide and panthenol, it helps refresh the look of dull, dehydrated and visibly red skin, leaving it feeling quenched, soothed and refreshed. Hydration can increase by up to 85% after a single use.*

Limited Edition Cryo Ball
A cooling facial massage tool designed to instantly refresh and soothe the look of tired, puffy skin. Glide it over the skin after cleansing or alongside your serum for a calming, spa-like boost whenever she needs five minutes to herself.

1 x Cleanse Off Mitt
A soft, reusable mitt that removes makeup and daily build-up with warm water. Suitable for all skin types, it's an easy first step to a simple double-cleanse routine - and just as handy at home, on holiday or after the gym.
sets.who:
For the sister who is always exhausted.

The one who is permanently running on too little sleep. The one who's first up, last to bed and somehow still doing everything for everyone else.

Their skin might be looking a little duller, more tired or less fresh than it once did.

This is for the busy sister, the overworked friend, the new mum, the one with a calendar that's always full or simply the person who could use a little pick-me-up.

sets.howTo:
15% Vit C, E + Tri-Mushroom Serum: After cleansing, apply a few drops to clean, dry skin in the morning. Follow with moisturiser and SPF.

Skin Protein: AM & PM: After cleansing, apply a pump to face, neck, decolletage and around the eye area. Follow with moisturiser and use SPF every morning.

Hydra-Hit Instant Facial Mask: After cleansing, unfold and apply the mask to the face. Leave for 15 minutes, then remove and gently massage the remaining serum into skin. No rinsing required.

Cryo Ball: Glide over cleansed skin or alongside your serum using gentle outward and upward movements. Use whenever skin looks tired or puffy and you want a cooling, refreshing facial massage.

Cleanse Off Mitt: Wet with warm water and gently sweep over the face to remove makeup and daily build-up. Use as the first step of a double cleanse if desired.
sets.ingredients:
15% Vitamin C - a  antioxidant that helps brighten dull-looking skin and improve the appearance of uneven tone.

Vitamin E - an antioxidant that helps support the skin and complement Vitamin C.

Reishi, Chaga + Cordyceps - a trio of mushrooms selected for their skin-supporting and antioxidant properties.

Retinyl Palmitate - a retinoid used in Skin Protein to support skin renewal and smoother, firmer-looking skin.

Pro-Collagen Peptide - helps support the look of firmer, smoother skin.

Niacinamide (Vitamin B3) - helps support the skin barrier and improve the look of uneven tone and texture.

Hyaluronic Acid - helps attract and retain moisture, leaving skin feeling hydrated and supple.

Glycerine - a humectant that helps draw moisture into the skin for a quenched, comfortable feel.
sets.tips:
Introduce Skin Protein gradually. If new to Vitamin A, start slowly and build up frequency as skin becomes accustomed to it.

Make Hydra-Hit their 15-minute reset. Apply after cleansing, put the phone down and leave it on for 15 minutes.

Reach for the Cryo Ball when skin looks tired. Use with gentle outward and upward movements for a cooling, refreshing facial massage.

Don't forget SPF. A broad-spectrum SPF should be the final step of a morning routine, every day.

sets.name: The Hydrate + Protect Edit
sets.strapline: Always walking, running, cycling, golfing, gardening, travelling, heading to the beach or simply happiest outside? The Hydrate + Protect Edit brings together the everyday essentials they need to keep skin hydrated, comfortable and protected.
sets.description:
With our award-winning Skin Shield SPF50 and Skin Veg Hyaluronic Acid Serum at its core, plus a hydration-boosting mask, cooling Cryo Ball and easy cleansing mitt, it's a simple routine for anyone who spends a lot of time outdoors.

And because we've created our Edits around skin goals rather than skin types, you don't need to know their entire skincare routine to gift with confidence.


Contains

1 x Skin Veg Hyaluronic Acid Hydrating Serum
A lightweight, hydrating daily serum enriched with fruit, vegetable and botanical extracts plus gentle PHA. It helps support the skin barrier and protect against environmental stressors, leaving skin feeling hydrated, smooth and comfortable.

1 x Skin Shield Moisturising + Priming SPF50 PA+++
Our multi-award-winning SPF50 with broad-spectrum UVA + UVB protection. Its lightweight, moisturising formula helps keep skin feeling smooth and comfortable, with niacinamide, vitamin E and allantoin for antioxidant support.

NEW Hydra-Hit Instant Facial Mask
A serum-soaked Korean sheet mask that delivers an instant hydration boost in just 15 minutes. Powered by glycerine, niacinamide and panthenol, it helps refresh the look of dull, dehydrated and visibly red skin, leaving skin feeling quenched, soothed and refreshed. Hydration can increase by up to 85% after a single use.*

Limited Edition Cryo Ball
A cooling facial massage tool designed to instantly refresh and soothe the look of tired, puffy skin. Glide it over the skin after cleansing or alongside your serum for a cooling, revitalising facial ritual.

1 x Cleanse Off Mitt
A soft, reusable mitt that removes makeup and daily build-up with warm water. Suitable for all skin types, it's an easy first step to a simple double-cleanse routine - whether they're at home, travelling or coming back from a day outdoors.
sets.who:
For the one who's outdoors more than they're in.

The dad who's always out walking. The boyfriend who cycles everywhere. The partner who spends weekends on the golf course. The brother who's permanently planning the next adventure. The friend who'd choose a hike over a lie-in every time.

They're happiest outside - but all that fresh air, changing weather and outdoor exposure means their skin needs some attention too.

This is for the person who doesn't think they need a skincare routine, but definitely needs SPF.

You don't need to know their skin type or what products they use. You just need to know they're always on the go.

sets.howTo:
Skin Veg - AM & PM: After cleansing, apply a pump to face, neck, decolletage and around the eye area.

Skin Shield SPF50: Apply as the final step of your morning skincare routine and reapply every 2 hours during the day.

Hydra-Hit Instant Facial Mask: After cleansing, unfold and apply the mask to the face. Leave for 15 minutes, then remove and gently massage the remaining serum into skin.

Cryo Ball : Glide over clean skin or alongside your serum using gentle outward and upward movements. Use whenever skin looks tired, puffy or in need of a cooling refresh.

sets.ingredients:
Hyaluronic Acid - helps attract and retain moisture to leave skin feeling hydrated, smooth and supple.

PHA - a gentle exfoliating acid that helps smooth the appearance of skin.

Niacinamide (Vitamin B3) - helps support the skin barrier and improve the appearance of uneven-looking tone and texture.

Zinc Oxide - a mineral UV filter that provides broad-spectrum protection against UVA and UVB rays.

Vitamin E - an antioxidant that helps support skin against environmental stressors.

Allantoin - helps soothe and comfort the feel of the skin.

Glycerine - a humectant that helps draw moisture into the skin for a hydrated, comfortable feel.

Panthenol - helps hydrate and soothe the feel of the skin.
sets.tips:
Make SPF the non-negotiable. Apply Skin Shield SPF50 as the final step of the morning routine and reapply as needed when spending time outdoors.

Hydrate before heading out. Apply Skin Veg after cleansing to help keep skin feeling hydrated and comfortable.

Don't forget the neck. Extend skincare and SPF down onto the neck and any other exposed areas as appropriate.

Use Hydra-Hit when skin needs a reset. Fifteen minutes is all it takes for an extra hydration boost.

Cool it down. Keep the Cryo Ball in the fridge for an extra-refreshing facial massage when skin is feeling hot, tired or puffy.

Cleanse after a day outside. Use the Cleanse Off Mitt to remove sunscreen, sweat and daily build-up before continuing with the evening routine.
